name: pinch-two-touch-gesture
description: a pinch with a coordinate center builds two symmetric touches and dispatches a two-pointer gesture when the driver reports canMultiPointer.
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pinch coord
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pinch:
    center: { x: 200, y: 200 }
    startGap: 40
    endGap: 120
